topic: Identifying user data source in controller
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on debugging how the `req.user` object, containing detailed user roles and IDs, was populated within a server controller endpoint. Initially, the source of this data was unclear despite checking guards and routing files. It was eventually determined that the data originates from the `JwtStrategy`, with the actual creation logic residing in the `AuthService`.
decisions: The source of the user object (`req.user`) is confirmed to be the `JwtStrategy`, created by the `AuthService`.
